items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: And then we made another movie with Billie Holiday, that was nice, really nice.

ctx.x: Yeah we did a show with her. And we did all kinds of things, man. Made a movie with Helen Humes. And then we made another movie with Billie Holiday, that was nice, really nice. And then I did a lot more with just different people when I got back in New York.
